scientific_key: From FNA: opposite tiny 1–3.2mm rounded entire leaves, purple ELLIPTIC cyathium glands with NO white appendages, 1.5–2mm seeds with 5–7 low transverse wrinkles. E. golondrina has larger narrower oblong leaf blades and circular reddish glands with white crescents. E. theriaca var. theriaca often indistinguishable without true ripe seed photo; smaller seed with 2–4 prominent ridges.
